functions.name: EROUTPUT
functions.description: Records value on each iteration and reports it in the results. Returns value.

functions.name: ERRUNOUTPUT
functions.description: Records value once at the end of each run. Returns value.

functions.name: ERSENSINPUT
functions.description: Names an input for sensitivity analysis. Returns value.

functions.name: ERRUNSENSINPUT
functions.description: Names an input for sensitivity analysis across runs. Returns value.

functions.name: ERDATA
functions.description: After the run, returns the value inp had on iteration itnum. Returns 0 during the run.

functions.name: ERDATAARRAY
functions.description: After the run, spills innum from every iteration down a column.

functions.name: ERRUNDATAARRAY
functions.description: After all runs, spills value from the end of every run down a column.

functions.name: ERMINIMIZE
functions.description: Parameters being optimised, starting from range ir. Spills to the same shape as ir.

functions.name: ERMINIMIZERESULT
functions.description: Loss value the optimiser minimises. Must share its name with ErMinimize.

functions.name: ERONEOFFCOSTDISC
functions.description: Cost co at time cy, discounted to base year by at fractional rate r.

functions.name: ERANNUALCOSTDISC
functions.description: Annual cost co from sy to ly, discounted to base year by at fractional rate r.

functions.name: ERLYDISC
functions.description: Life years from sy to ly, discounted to base year by at fractional rate r.

functions.name: ERHALYDISC
functions.description: Health-adjusted life years from sy to ly, using weights ha by single year of age ag.

functions.name: ERFIXED
functions.description: Returns element num of range x, wrapping around past the end.

functions.name: ERCONDITIONAL
functions.description: Returns value when con is TRUE. Otherwise holds the previous result.

functions.name: ERTRUNCATE
functions.description: Resamples an embedded random function until it falls between min and max.

functions.name: ERITERATION
functions.description: Number of the current iteration.

functions.name: ERSETITNO
functions.description: Sets the number of iterations from the worksheet.

functions.name: ERRUNNO
functions.description: Number of the current run.

functions.name: ERRUNNING
functions.description: TRUE while a simulation is running.

functions.name: ERVERSION
functions.description: Version of this add-in.

functions.name: ERSTORE
functions.description: Stores a number for the next iteration. Returns name.

functions.name: ERRETRIEVE
functions.description: Number stored by ErStore on the previous iteration. 0 on the first.

functions.name: ERSTOREARRAY
functions.description: Stores a range for the next iteration. Returns name.

functions.name: ERRETRIEVEARRAY
functions.description: Range stored by ErStoreArray on the previous iteration.

functions.name: ERCONDSTOREARRAY
functions.description: Stores a range when condition is TRUE. mode 0 replaces, 1 multiplies, 2 adds.

functions.name: ERCONDRETRIEVEARRAY
functions.description: Range stored by ErCondStoreArray, updated when condition is TRUE.

functions.name: ERSORTEDARRAY
functions.description: Sorts a range. mode 1 is ascending, anything else descending.

functions.name: ERMEAN
functions.description: At the end of a run, the mean of inp across its iterations.

functions.name: ERSTDEV
functions.description: At the end of a run, the standard deviation of inp across its iterations.

functions.name: ERMIN
functions.description: At the end of a run, the lowest value of inp across its iterations.

functions.name: ERMAX
functions.description: At the end of a run, the highest value of inp across its iterations.

functions.name: ERTOTAL
functions.description: At the end of a run, the sum of inp across its iterations.

functions.name: ERCORRELATION
functions.description: At the end of a run, the Pearson correlation of X and Y across its iterations.

functions.name: ERPERCENTILE
functions.description: At the end of a run, percentile perc (0 to 100) of inp across its iterations.
